config.record_grain: One row per ASIC Business Names Register business-name registration record, representing a registered or recently deregistered business name rather than necessarily a legal entity

fields.evidence: ASIC Business Names Dataset Help File, p. 7, data dictionary: BN_NAME is “A name used, or to be used, in relation to one or more businesses” and is the Business Name as it appears on ASIC’s Business Names register; sample header BN_NAME and row values such as “Plumbing Gas and Solar”.

unmapped_fields.reason: Register label (“BUSINESS NAMES”), not a legal entity name, trading name, identifier, address, or ontology status.

Describes registration status of the business name, not the status of a legal entity; the ontology has no business-name registration-status target, and cancellation does not prove entity deregistration.

This is the date the business name started/was registered, not a legal entity registration date. The ontology’s entity.date_registered must not receive a business-name registration date. ASIC Help File, p. 8, defines BN_REG_DT as the date by which the Business Name started.

This is the date the business name ceased, not a legal-entity deregistration date; the ontology has no business-name cancellation-date target. ASIC Help File, p. 8, specifies it is populated when the Business Name has been cancelled.
Former state-registration identifying number allocated by a previous business-names regulator before 28 May 2012; no ontology target and not a current legal-entity identifier. ASIC Help File, p. 8.
Previous state of registration under a former business-names regulator, not a current entity/address state; no suitable ontology target. ASIC Help File, p. 8.

Although documented as an Australian Business Number, this business-name-register field may be NULL for suppressed, multiple, or unavailable ABNs and does not establish the legal identity or ownership of the business-name holder. The supplied provenance semantics require identifiers to remain unmapped when holder/ownership is unsupported; no ACN inference is made. ASIC Help File, p. 9, states the field can be NULL in these cases.

limitations: The source is a snapshot of ASIC’s Business Names Register, not a company register; a row is not necessarily a legal entity record.
BN_NAME is retained as a raw subject label and mapped only as a trading-name claim; no legal-name or ownership claim is made.
No legal entity, company type, branch, address, licence, or reporting-group fields are supplied.
Publication timestamp 2026-09-15T20:36:19.202924 is used by the source envelope as an allowed observation proxy, not as a row-change timestamp.
ASIC states the dataset includes currently registered business names and deregistered business names for the preceding 12 months (Help File, p. 2); coverage outside that window is not represented.
All authority and field-confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
